name: Hetter Slagjaw
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The Slagborn raid leader camped on the jungle edge above Port Vharl, with a jaw of cooled slag where his own was broken off. He throws pots of molten slag that leave burning pools, and brands the farthest player for the fire (a circle that follows them — take it away from the group). At 60% he calls two raiders and pours slag over his own wounds (interrupt it). At 30% he swings his slag chain wide: get in close.
party: Open world elite. Solo: tough at level — kite the brand, interrupt the rite. 2-3: intended. 5+: quick. M5 scaling: health by players tagged; raiders 2 -> 3 at five; slag pots +1 per extra player.

pull: Fresh skin for the slag! Hold them down!
The mountain wants feeding. You will do.
Hetter grins with his iron jaw. It does not move when he talks.
say.death: Hetter Slagjaw falls face first into his own slag. It hisses.
say.reset: Hetter stamps back to his fire, muttering a rite.

slag_pot.name: Slag Pot
slag_pot.say: Hetter hurls pots of molten slag!

brand.name: Slag Brand
brand.say: Hetter marks {target} for the fire — run it away from the others!

rite.name: Slag Rite
rite.say: Hetter pours molten slag over his own wounds — stop him!

onInterrupt.say: The ladle clangs off his jaw. Hetter swears in three languages.

chain.name: Slag Chain
chain.say: Hetter swings the slag chain wide — get in close!

phases.name: Raiders!
phases.say: Raiders! To me! Bring the ladle!

phases.name: Molten
phases.say: Enough! The mountain takes you NOW.
